name: Feather Fall
summary: A reaction that slows the descent of up to five falling creatures so they land unharmed.

castingTime.trigger: when you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you falls

m.text: a small feather or piece of down

stats.effect: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If a creature lands before the spell ends, the creature takes no damage from the fall, and the spell ends for that creature.
